title: Running a level with a crew
target: How to work a level as a team so the loot reaches extraction, based on the gear and extraction behaviour the game defines.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A crew of two or more

steps.do: Agree who carries what before you split up.
steps.because: gear and loot are individual carried items in the game rather than a shared pool (ItemWalkieTalkie, ItemValuableBox)

steps.do: Keep a way to reach each other.
steps.because: a walkie-talkie exists as its own item (ItemWalkieTalkie)

steps.do: Carry a revive item instead of assuming help will arrive.
steps.because: reviving crew members uses a dedicated item (ItemReviveItem)

steps.do: Bank one extraction as a crew before deciding to go deeper.
steps.because: extractions happen at tracked points and are recorded (ExtractionPoint, ExtractionsDoneState)

commonMistakes: Splitting up with no way to talk.
One player carrying everything worth taking.
Never extracting because there is always one more item.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
